chapter_title: The Explanation of the Peace, what it is; the Righ
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
:
 The Five
 Mysteries of the Celestial Mind


---


**
¶2.
** These
 five spiritual
 operations are the hidden
 nature
 of the celestial will
 as
 it proceeds
 from the Divine
 itself. It
 descended
 with them
 out
 of the heavenly state. And
 when it had
 completed its passage through temptation,
 it ascended again bearing
 these same modes of conjunction.
 The
 heav
enly states received it back into themselves.


**
¶3.** The first tran
quility is the interior
 rest
 that
 all
 the goods
 and truths dwelling
 in heaven best
owed upon the celestial will
 as
 it prepared
 to go
 forth
 against
 evil
. All
 the goods and truths of
 heaven went
 with
 it,
 sustained
 it
, and p
oured into it their
 peace and their
 power,
 their bened
iction and their strength
. This is the first tran
quility that the goods
 and truths of heaven gave to the
 celestial will as it came
 forth from the heavenly state.


**¶4.** The first
 communication
 of divine power is the one
 that the Divine Love itself gave
 to the celestial will as
 it went
 forth into
 temptation.


**¶5.** The
 first intimate
 conjunction
 is that
 by
 which the Divine Love united
 itself wholly
 with
 the celestial will as
 it separated and
 descended into temptation. Indeed
 all
 the goods
 and truths that
 d
well in the
 heavenly states
 sought
 to unite
 themselves with it
 —
 all of
 them,
 and the guardian
 principles of the spiritual community
, and every
 kind
red good
 belonging
 to the household of its
 origin
. They all
 sought to unite themselves with it as it
 separated from them, accompanying it out
ward, con
joining themselves
 to
 it through
 the bond
 of affection and love.

**
¶6.** The first act
 of hum
iliation is the
 acknowledg
ment by
 which the celestial will submitted itself before
 going
 down
 into the
 lower
 states
.
 It bent
 its own
 self
-will and
 made itself
 low
 before the Divine Truth
 itself
, and
 before
 all the heav
enly states belonging
 to the household of its origin
,
 entre
ating them for an
 influx of power to sust
ain it as
 it went
 forth.

**¶7.
** The first full
 transmission
 of divine power is the one that the
 Divine Love best
owed upon the in
most understanding
 of the celestial will.
 She
 furnished
 it with tru
ths for combat
 and
 made
 it mighty. She commun
icated her
 own
 power into
 it and
 sent
 it forth into the struggle
. It descended.
 It completed its trial
 against
 the great forces
 of
 evil and 
enmity.

**¶8
.** By these five spiritual
 operations and these five hidden
 modes
 of conjunction, the celestial will went
 forth from
 the heavenly states
 against evil
. It subd
ued evil
.
 It prev
ailed over
 it by means
 of them
.

**¶9.**
 And when it
 ascended from the combat
, it entered
 again
 into the kingdom
 of its
 heav
enly community
 by
 these same
 five operations
.


**¶10.** The
 tran
quility with
 which it
 ascended is the peace
 that the Divine Call
 commun
icated to it when that
 call was sent forth from the Divine
 Wisdom.
 It gave the
 celest
ial will its
 peace even
 within
 the state of fals
ity and
 evil
. And
 that peace with which it had
 first
 descended is the very
 same
 as
 the one
 by
 which it was
 raised
 from the struggle.
 *
[
This
 corresponds
 closely
 to
 Swedenborg's teaching
 that the
 peace which
 prec
edes tem
ptation and
 the peace which follows it are one
 and the same peace
 —
 the Lord
's own
 life
 flowing
 through
 all
 states
.
]*

**¶11.**
 The
 second communication of divine power is the one
 that the Divine Proce
eding gave
 to the celestial will when
 it drew
 it upward out of the struggle.


**¶12.** The
 second intimate conjunction is the
 one by which the Divine Wisdom and
 the
 Divine Love together
 united themselves with the celestial will when
 it ascended from the combat
.


**¶13.** The
 second act of humiliation is that
 by
 which the celestial will made
 acknowledg
ment —
 this
 time in
 grat
itude — before
 the Divine Truth
 and
 before all
 the blessed
 heavenly states and
 all the orders
 of heaven
 and
 the whole
 of
 the spiritual
 world
,
 when
 the Divine Wisdom
 and the Divine Love brought it
 upward out
 of the a
byss of tem
ptation.

**¶14
.** The second full
 transmission of divine power is this
: When the Divine Proceeding drew
 the celestial will upward from
 the combat
, it saved it from all the overwhelming
 floods
 of
 falsity.
 It raised
 it up.
 It gave it rest
 within
 the great heavenly states belonging
 to the community
 of its origin. It established
 it firmly in
 the presence
 of the Divine itself
, the Lord of all
 things that
 exist
. It received this ultimate
 communication
 of power so
 that it might become a governing
 use
 among
 its
 kind
red in the new heavenly state.


**¶15.** These
 five operations and these five modes of conjunction
 originated first
 in the Divine itself.
 These
 interior
 work
ings never existed,
 from
 the beginning, among the states of evil
 and falsity.
 *
[That
 is:
 tem
ptation-
combat and
 its
 resolution
 through
 conjunction
 are
 wholly
 of
 divine
 origin;
 the h
ells have
 no corresponding
 process
,
 for
 evil
 cannot
 regener
ate itself.]*

---


**
¶20.** Once
 more
: At the time of their departure
 from
 the body
, the Divine Human shall
 appear
 before
 them and
 shall lib
erate them from fals
ity into
 wisdom
. This appearance
 of the Divine Human cal
ms the spirit
, through
 intimate
 conjunction and
 through still
ness, from the terror
 of the
 evil
 spirits who destroy the natural
 life
. By her presence
 and her
 lik
eness, the in
most will of the regenerated one
 who
 is
 depar
ting from the body is
 made
 calm.
 Afterward
, the ang
elic truth
 bearing
 the reward of a life well
-lived extends
 divine
 power to him
 and
 draws
 him out of the depth
 of the
 natural
 and
 corpor
eal degree
,
 and receives
 him through
 the bond
 of love
.
 That interior
 spirit
 shall make its
 acknowledg
ment before its
 redeemer, who is this same
 Divine Human. And at
 the very
 instant of
 that
 acknowledgment, it
 shall be perfected and brought
 to fullness according
 to its
 own measure
 of
 reception
, within
 the community
 of the living,
 among
 all
 the goods
 and truths of heaven.
 And
 it receives
 the crown of wisdom and
 the glory of eternal blessedness in
 the
 life that
 has
 no
 end.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: So, these five signs are the mystery of the First Man. He came forth with them from the aeon of light. Also, when he finished his contest, he went up with these good signs. They received him into the aeons of light.

The first peace is the one that the gods and the angels in the land of light gave to the First Man; when he comes out against the enemy. The gods and the angels were walking with him; escorting him, giving to him their peace and power, and their blessing and fortification. This is the first peace that the gods and the angels gave to the First Man; as he comes forth from the aeon of light.
The first right hand is the one that the Mother of Life gave to the First Man; when he comes out to the contest.

The first kiss is this one with which the Mother of Life embraced the First Man; as he separates from her, coming down to the contest. Even all the gods and the angels who are in the aeons of light were making to embrace him! [And they embraced him and kissed him,] all of them also, and the church tutelaries (?), and the kinsfolk who belong to the household of his people. They were making to embrace him as [he] separates from them, accompanying him out, embracing him with the kiss of affection and love.

The first salutation is the salutation with which the First Man made obeisance; when he comes out [to the depths] below. He was bending his knees, making obeisance to the God of truth, and all the aeons [of light] who belong to the household of his people; entreating them for a power to escort him, as he comes forth.

The first laying on of hands is the one that the Mother of Life bequeathed upon the head of the First Man. She armed him and made him mighty. She laid hands on him, and sent him to the battle. He descended. He completed his struggle with the great powers and the enmity.
By the[se] five signs and these five myst[e]ri[es] the First Man came forth from the aeons of light against the enemy. He humbled him. He was victorious against him by them.
Also, when he ascended from the war, he came in to the kingdom of the household of his people by these five mysteries!

The peace with which [he ascen]ded is the peace that the summons gave to him, [w]hen it was sent forth from the [Fa]ther of Life. It gave him the peace in the world of darkness. Also, that peace with which he descended is th[e sam]e as the one with which he ascended from the struggle!
Again, this second right hand is the one that the Living Spirit gave the First Man, when he [brou]ght him upward out from the struggle.
Also, this second kiss is the one with which the [Father o]f Life and the Mother of the living embraced the First Man, when he ascended from the struggle.

[The] second salutation with which the First Man made obeisance [is the salutation that he made in gratitude; this] time to the God of truth and [to all] the blessed aeons and al[l] the aeons [of light, and the] whole [land] of light, whe[n] the Father of Life and the Mother of the living brought the Man upward from the abyss of the struggle.

The second laying on of hands is this: When the Living Spirit brought the First Man upward from the war, he saved him from all the surging waves. He brought him upward, he gave him ease in the great aeons of light, which belong to the household of his people. He set [him] firmly before the Father, the Lord of the totality. Now, when he went up before the great Father of the lights, a voice came forth to him from the heights, saying: [Come, thou who hast prevailed in the contest; receive the power and the authority over thy brethren.] He received this great laying on of hands that he may become leader of his brethren in the new aeon.

At the time of their coming forth, the Light Form shall come forth before them; and she redeems them from the darkness to the light [ ... ] This Light Form calms the person, with the kiss and her quiet, from fear of the demons w[ho de]stroy his body. By her asp[ec]t and her image [the] heart of the elect one, who is come forth from his bo[d]y, shall be calm for [him]. Afterwards, the angel who h[o]lds the victory prize extends to him the right hand. And it draws him out of the abyss of his body, and accepts him in with the [k]iss and love. That soul shall make obeisance to its red[eem]er, who is this Light Form. And also, at the inst[ant when ... ] he shall be perfected and increased according to [ ... / ... ] in the household of the living ones, with the go[ds] and the angel[s] [An]d he receives the crown [ ... ] glory in the life for ever.
